# linear_git_automation_state (Resource)

Manages one git automation rule of a Linear team: when the given git event fires, linked issues move to the given workflow state.

Each Linear `GitAutomationState` covers exactly one event, so five events means five resources. Combined with `linear_git_automation_target_branch` this also expresses per-branch overrides — a rule with `target_branch_id` set applies only to pull requests targeting that branch pattern and overrides the team's default rule for the same event.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One resource per git event. Bundling all five into one resource is what stops
# `merge` round-tripping elsewhere.
resource "linear_git_automation_state" "start" {
  team_id  = linear_team.engineering.id
  event    = "start"
  state_id = linear_workflow_state.in_progress.id
}

resource "linear_git_automation_state" "review" {
  team_id  = linear_team.engineering.id
  event    = "review"
  state_id = linear_workflow_state.in_review.id
}

resource "linear_git_automation_state" "merge" {
  team_id  = linear_team.engineering.id
  event    = "merge"
  state_id = linear_workflow_state.done.id
}

# A rule scoped to a branch pattern overrides the team default for that event.
resource "linear_git_automation_state" "merge_to_main" {
  team_id          = linear_team.engineering.id
  event            = "merge"
  state_id         = linear_workflow_state.released.id
  target_branch_id = linear_git_automation_target_branch.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event` (String) Git event that triggers the rule — one of `draft` (draft PR opened), `start` (branch created), `review` (PR ready for review), `mergeable` (PR approved and mergeable) or `merge` (PR merged).
- `team_id` (String) UUID of the team the rule belongs to. Changing it replaces the rule — `gitAutomationStateUpdate` has no `teamId`.

### Optional

- `state_id` (String) UUID of the workflow state linked issues move to. Leave unset to make the rule take no action — which is how a team overrides an inherited default for this event.
- `target_branch_id` (String) UUID of a `linear_git_automation_target_branch` this rule is scoped to. Unset means the rule applies to pull requests against any branch.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the automation rule.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import linear_git_automation_state.example a1b2c3d4-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
